alt: 救援人員穿戴安全裝備，在同伴支援下從救援艇伸出繩索協助受困家庭。
scene_prompt: Modern community flood rescue. A trained adult rescue volunteer in proper life vest and helmet stands securely on a rescue boat, extending a rope toward a stranded family on a stable raised platform while another rescuer supports them. Show courage and selfless duty with safe teamwork, no injury or death. Natural anatomy, plausible rope grips, boat and waterline.
